modules.description: Canonical business context, evidence, decisions, actions, measurement, learning, governance, runtime contracts, schemas, capabilities, and shared policies.
modules.smoke_task: Coordinate several opportunities toward one business outcome
modules.welcome_summary: Coordinate business context, evidence, opportunities, actions, verification, measurement, learning, tools, and cross-system work.
example_prompts: What should we work on first?
What are the highest-value opportunities you can identify with what is installed?

modules.description: Research and maintain evidence-backed understanding of customers, prospects, pains, desires, objections, decision drivers, language, experiences, and outcomes.
modules.welcome_summary: Understand customers and prospects: what they want, why they buy or leave, their pains, objections, decision drivers, language, and experiences.
example_prompts: Why are customers leaving?
What objections are stopping prospects from buying?
What do our best customers value most?

modules.description: Adaptively discover, resolve, observe, traverse, compare, and interpret competitor identity, websites/funnels, pricing, offers, ads, content/social, customer sentiment, tactics, strategy, strengths, weaknesses, and material changes.
modules.welcome_summary: Understand competitors deeply: identity, websites/funnels, pricing, offers, ads, content/social, customer sentiment, tactics, strengths, weaknesses, and important changes—with research depth adapted to the decision.
example_prompts: What are our competitors doing better than us?
Do a comprehensive competitive analysis of our top competitors.
Trace our main competitor funnels and advertising themes.
What competitor weaknesses can we take advantage of?

modules.description: Monitor, verify, interpret, and track material regulation, research, technology, market, category, cultural, platform, and news developments.
modules.smoke_task: Analyze an important new regulation in our industry
modules.welcome_summary: Track important external developments such as news, regulation, research, technology, market shifts, platform changes, and category trends.
example_prompts: What changed in our industry that matters to us?
How does this new regulation affect our business?
What emerging trends should we act on?

modules.description: Diagnose, plan, execute, verify, and learn from organic discovery across search, answer engines, AI interfaces, local, and related organic surfaces.
modules.smoke_task: Diagnose why our organic rankings dropped
modules.welcome_summary: Improve organic discovery across search engines, AI/answer engines, local search, technical SEO, content, authority, and related visibility.
example_prompts: What are our biggest SEO/AEO opportunities?
Why did our organic traffic or rankings decline?
Create the highest-value organic page we are missing.

modules.description: Research content patterns and turn validated ideas, evidence, and source material into platform-native text, image, carousel, presentation, audio, video, animation, and derivative assets.
modules.smoke_task: Create a LinkedIn post from this source for our audience
modules.welcome_summary: Research what works and create platform-native content across articles, social posts, newsletters, carousels, video, audio, presentations, and more.
example_prompts: Turn this idea into a strong LinkedIn post.
Create a content plan from our best customer insights.
Turn this source into native content for several platforms.

modules.description: Diagnose and create commercial persuasion: positioning, messaging, proof architecture, Offer presentation, ads, landing pages, VSLs, webinars, email, and related conversion assets.
modules.welcome_summary: Create and improve persuasive marketing: positioning, messaging, offers, proof, ads, landing pages, VSLs, webinars, email, and conversion assets.
example_prompts: Create a campaign around our biggest customer objection.
Improve this landing page so more people convert.
Build a webinar to sell this offer.

modules.description: Diagnose and improve conversion, purchase, onboarding, activation, success, retention, repeat, expansion, referral, and other customer-journey transitions.
modules.welcome_summary: Improve the customer journey from conversion through purchase, onboarding, activation, retention, repeat purchase, expansion, and referral.
example_prompts: Why are customers dropping out before buying?
Improve our onboarding and time-to-value.
Find the biggest causes of churn and what to change.
